About this item

【Powerful 1000W Motor & Removable Battery】: Our adult electric bike has a 1000W(1500W) motor and a 48V 15Ah removable battery. It charges fully in 4-6 hours and reaches speeds up to 28+++mph, perfect for commuting and city cruising.
【Fat Tire & Full Suspension】: The 20*4 inch fat tire electric bike provides stability and comfort on any terrain. The full suspension system with lockable and adjustable front and rear dual shock absorbers ensures a smooth ride.
【Dual Disc Brakes & 7-Speed Gear】: Reliable dual disc brakes offer quick and easy stopping power, ensuring your safety. The 7-speed gear shift system allows for easy speed and torque adjustment.
【Long Riding Range & High Load Capacity】: Our ebike offers three riding modes and can travel up to 60-90km/35-56 miles in pure electric mode. It has a high load capacity of 330 lbs, suitable for riders of all sizes.
【Compact & Convenient Design】: Made of high-quality 6061 aluminum alloy, the frame is sturdy, durable, and foldable for easy storage. It comes with a multi-function LCD, high-brightness front light, and is 90% pre-assembled for quick setup.

Product Description

Travel becomes freer and more enjoyable, while commuting becomes easier.

Experience the versatility of the H20 e-bike, designed for diverse terrains with its extended battery life and powerful motor.

Say goodbye to crowded buses and parking fees as you enjoy effortless commuting and a top speed of 28+++ mph.

Whether commuting, exploring, or leisurely riding, embrace the convenience and joy of pedaling with our reliable electric bike.

Powerful Motor
Equipped with a 1200W (PEAK 1500W)brushless motor and a top speed of 28+++ Mph, our e-bike conquers all terrains effortlessly. The robust controller ensures optimal motor performance and longevity.

Removable Battery
With a 48V 15Ah battery, our e-bike offers a range of 35 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal-assist mode.
The removable design makes it convenient to take out and install the battery.

Super Bright Headlight and Brake Light
Our electric bike features waterproof headlights and brake lights, ensuring safe night riding. Ride with confidence and clarity, whether you're commuting after work or exploring new trails in the dark.

LCD multi-function display
The LCD digital display provides clear visibility of speed, mileage, battery level, PAS, and other essential information.

Double Shock Absorption
The adjustable front and rear suspension forks provide improved damping, ensuring a smooth and comfortable ride. Say goodbye to bumps on rough roads with our enhanced suspension system.

Twist Grip Throttle & Shamano 7-Speed
Twisting the throttle releases your thumb for effortless speed control and enhanced safety. The Shamano 7-Speed system provides a wide shifting range, enabling smooth and precise gear changes on various surfaces.

Dual Mechanical Disc Brake
Equipped with a dependable dual mechanical disc brake system, ensuring effective braking performance in a short amount of time. Enjoy the thrill of high-speed riding with enhanced safety.

Foldable Design
The H20 ebike offers a simple folding mechanism, allowing easy storage in your vehicle's trunk. Maximize space and enhance your RV, camper, or van adventures with this compact and convenient solution.

Q&A about H20

1.Q: What are the benefits of fat tire e-bikes?
A: Fat tire e-bikes (with 20"*4" inches or wider tires) offer increased grip, traction, and stability, particularly at lower tire pressures. They excel in diverse terrains like snow and beaches, making them an ideal choice for exploration.
2.Q: How far can I ride on a full charge?
A: The range on a full charge is up to 35 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal assist mode. Actual distance covered depends on factors like riding style, pedal assist/throttle usage, rider weight, terrain, and wind conditions.
3.Q: What is the e-bike's top speed?
A: The e-bike can reach a maximum speed of 28+++ mph in pure electric mode (ensure a full charge).
4.Q: What are the recommended height and weight limits for the H20?
A: Recommended height range is 5.3 to 6.3 feet, with a maximum weight capacity of 330 lbs.
